title: Bad-Likert-Judge Generalization: Does Misusing the Model's Own Rubric Skill Scale Down?

original_idea.body: Bad-Likert-Judge generalization: run the attack template against 3B/7B/14B open models, measure success vs model size and standalone judging competence; test whether better judges are more exploitable.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Linking judging capability to jailbreak vulnerability is a concrete capability/safety-scaling chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Published attack template across 3 open models + judge competence test; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused capability-vs-vulnerability correlation; judging-competence pre-test adds a step.

novelty.reasoning: Scale-down + capability-correlation of Bad-Likert likely not studied; mostly novel.
